key_features.name: angled facade
key_features.description: A distinctive feature of the building's design, the angled facade adds a touch of futurism to the structure.

key_features.name: tapered top
key_features.description: The tapered top of the skyscraper gives it a sense of dynamism and movement, characteristic of cyberpunk architecture.

key_features.name: cantilevered roof
key_features.description: The cantilevered roof adds a sense of drama and tension to the building's design, creating a sense of weightlessness.
